50% legal equity in Japan USDC distribution JV; Circle also owns 50% and consolidates the VIE due to control.

Named as exchange access partners, not founding validators.

hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail digital-finance strategy rather than exclusive reliance on XRP/Ripple.
support: 50:50 Circle JV and USD50M Circle equity investment
SBI Group founding validator on Circle Arc
JPYSC with Startale and SBI Shinsei Trust
SBI's longstanding Ripple/SBI Ripple Asia relationship
counter_hypothesis: Different rails may serve distinct customer segments and regulatory use cases; this does not prove a shift away from XRP.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase has material institutional crypto collateral operations but public filings do not establish meaningful XRP collateral usage.
support: Recognized derivative collateral table lists BTC and ETH only
Other recognized lending crypto totals USD9.903M
counter_hypothesis: USD2.804B of unrecognized customer crypto collateral is not token-level disclosed; XRP may be included there or in other affiliates/products.

hypotheses.claim: Circle and Coinbase have a materially interdependent USDC distribution/economic relationship.
support: Circle Q2 distribution costs to Coinbase USD324.6M
Circle says payouts depend on USDC held on Coinbase platform and ecosystem-growth allocation
Coinbase Q3 reports USD22B average USDC in products and USD306.905M stablecoin revenue
counter_hypothesis: These figures use different periods and definitions; they do not establish a direct causal link to XRP price or XRP demand.

hypotheses.claim: Circle Arc could compete with XRPL for institutional stablecoin settlement and collateral use, while the networks may coexist.
support: Arc USDC gas, sub-second finality, permissioned institutional validators, USYC/BUIDL/private-credit collateral
SBI Group is a founding validator
counter_hypothesis: No evidence that Arc replaces XRPL or that XRP is excluded from all future integrations; no operational volume comparison is available.
